Subject: Urgent: Newbridge pilot - affinity and routing feature ask

Team — forwarding Newbridge's pilot ask (attached). High level: they need a tenant-aware affinity/routing control so their latency-sensitive flows are consistently routed to a pinned pool and we preserve KV-cache locality. They want pilot in production by ~2027-07-15 as a hard business milestone tied to a staged payment (first-year ARR ~ $1.2M).

Attachments: Newbridge_requirements_v2.pdf, SOW_Newbridge_vDraft.docx

What I need from product/eng: a quick feasibility call + whether we can scope a narrow MLP for the pilot (limited to: affinity header + tenant pinning + expose telemetry). Customer is open to a short-term contractual workaround but prefers a platform-level capability.

Next steps I'm proposing:
- Quick triage call tomorrow 9am PT (please confirm availability).
- If feasible, scope an MLP and estimate dev + QA effort (target: <6 weeks).

Appreciate quick turnaround — they are a strategic account with expansion potential.

—Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Urgent: Newbridge pilot - affinity and routing feature ask

Thanks for the context, Dylan — and thanks Alex for the doc. Quick notes after a skim:

1) Business ask is clear (latency SLAs for a set of tenant flows) and timeline is aggressive (~6 weeks).
2) We need concrete success criteria from the customer: target p99/p50 latencies, acceptable token cost delta, and operational ownership for the pilot (who will validate).
3) Product constraints: we don't currently have a first-class "tenant pinning" API. We do have prefix caching, affinity by model variant, and routing policies that can be composed.

Ben — can you do a 30m triage with Dylan + Laura tomorrow to outline an MLP? I want a short spec (1 page) that we can show Newbridge to lock acceptance criteria.

If we can't hit feature in 6 weeks, propose a temporary contractual approach (dedicated pool + manual routing rules) and the effort to maintain it.

I'll open a feature request ticket and tag for prioritization once we have the MLP scope and business cert.

—Marissa
Sr. PM, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Newbridge pilot - affinity and routing feature ask

Looping in engineering perspective after reading the requirement doc. High-level technical takeaways:

- Feasibility: doable as a focused feature set. Core pieces: 1) routing policy with tenant pin, 2) KV-cache affinity preservation at inference runtime (cache key scoping), 3) telemetry/reporting per pinned pool.
- Estimated effort: ~4 dev-weeks + 1 week QA + 1 week rollout/observability hardening = ~6 development weeks if we treat as high priority and limit scope (no UI polish). This assumes we can carve a small dedicated sprint slot (2-3 engineers).
- Risks: impacts to caching layer and autoscaler heuristics; if affinity is too strict we may reduce utilization. Need a canary and robust fallback (auto-unpin after threshold).
- Workaround: we can provide an interim operational model — create a small dedicated pool for Newbridge and route via an API header ("X-Newbridge-Pin: true") with engineering-run guardrails. That gets them close to required performance in ~2 weeks but requires manual ops and monitoring.

I'll file PROD-4142 with technical details and example request/response shapes. If product confirms MLP scope today we can slot a spike into next sprint planning.

Ben
Engineering Manager, Runtime | Redwood Inference

Sales note / CS urgency: Newbridge has signaled the pilot date is contractual for the Q3 onboarding window. If we miss the 15-Jul pilot start they will defer rollout to Q4 and push renewal timing. Deal economics: first-year ARR ~ $1.2M, expansion upside ~ $3M over 2 years.

They are comfortable with an interim ops workaround but prefer platform capability — they flagged security/traceability needs too (audit logs for routing decisions). I pulled the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765 — the customer is rated high on strategic priority.

From a CS standpoint, I'm supportive of prioritizing a narrow MLP. If eng can commit to the ~6-week delivery we will accept the limited scope (API + pinning + telemetry). If eng can only do the 2-week ops workaround, we should still take it but escalate the platform roadmap in parallel.

—Monica

- Eng estimates: 6-week small-scope MLP OR 2-week ops workaround with manual pool + header.
- Deal value/urgency: first-year ARR ~$1.2M; strategic expansion potential.

I'll update the HubSpot deal and inform the customer that we're actively triaging. If we decide to prioritize as P1 I'll request a leadership sign-off for sprint reallocation.
